title: Record the owner-indexed y0 defect and its monomial charge
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped identity and field ledger. No new κ. The selected conditional value stays `781451/250000000` from the selected record (PR #6030). This does not change the selected frontier.

On the published two-edge feed, every owner-indexed D-exponent-0 left map of the four final banks that keeps `x0 = D1 Q^{-1}` and clears y0 satisfies

```text
m1 + m0 C1 = -Q^{-1} + Q^{-1} C1 Q C1.
```

The constant index writes that defect into a fresh image. The four stored endpoint banks are not overwritten. The image's x1 block remains the published three-term coefficient and is unpaid.

This is an algebra identity on the replayed banks, not a bounded search and not a claim that every physical quotient is as expensive. The field ledger is one factored circuit under inherited units: 2016 scalar ADDs, 672 monomial passes, 32 mode CLEARs, 224 COPYs, and 336 extra fields. It is not a minimum and not a tape proof.

## Task and overlap

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Card `joint-query-controller`, scope **refined**. The card's demand is not changed. This is the owner-indexed remainder of handoff discussion comment 19138525 after `research/coded-active-feedback` restored the missing coefficient.

Nearest work, and why this is distinct:

- `research/coded-active-feedback` (upstream) restores `A` only together with the y0 coupling and stops at an 8,281-policy search. It does not give this owner index or this charge.
- Fork draft PR 152, package `research/active-feedback-coupling-lock`, proves the declared alternating family cannot separate the witness monomials, and notes one odd-Q correction without an owner-index identity or a monomial charge. That census is not rerun. The new statement is the defect identity for every D-exponent-0 owner index, plus the charge for the constant-index image.
- The question of one feedback edge outside the 8,281-policy family is not taken.

Local overlap at the base commit searched the complete note inventory and found no note containing both "owner-indexed" and "y0 coupling". The remote overlap cache was absent. A live open-PR search for `y0` returned no CrocSwap pull requests. That is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only. Normal and optimized registered commands both pass:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/owner-indexed-y0-clearance --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/owner-indexed-y0-clearance
```

Checks are explicit `need` failures. They cover the pinned replay, the finite products, the defect identity including a relocation of `Q^{-1}` into `m0`, the fresh image, dropped-monomial failures, and the ledger arithmetic. No native build, network fetch, or full multiplier replay is used. `Q` and `Q^{-1}` are charged as one monomial pass each, the predecessor's `Q^2` unit; a three-factor expansion of `Q^{-1}` is not settled.

## Credit

Cinna Davis, `research/coded-active-feedback`, using Dugongue's PR4948 chronology, Dillon's PR4933 code, and the passive ceiling packaged by Chris R / Clear1nsight. The uncharged one-point correction is fork PR 152. The gauge engine is the inherited `research/coded-native-caller/gauge.py`.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Can a fresh image clear the three-term x1 block while keeping x0, keeping y0 zero, and leaving the four final banks stored unchanged? Start with the same four-bank equation on the x1 column. This package leaves that coefficient in place.

Does one inherited monomial pass implement `Q` and `Q^{-1}`? Bind the source primitive for a single power of `Q` before treating 672 monomial passes as a tape cost.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The revision-8 priority note still prints κ = 0.00310045 from PR #5599, while `certificates/selected-result.json` has `781451/250000000`. The selected record is the right orientation pin. One link to the feedback discussion is enough: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
